title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Parts Kit Pricing by Place on the Appointment
content:
Each kit's place in a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment decides how much of the price of a kit it carries. The kits are counted in order, the kits already standing on the appointment's installation parts kit entries first and the kits owed after them. The schedule follows how many appliances the appointment installs — the major appliance units sold on the purchase being delivered less those returned from it, as that purchase's lines under Northgate Purchases & Returns show them:

| Appliances the appointment installs | Share of the price of a kit by place |
|---|---|
| Three or more | The first kit carries the full price and every later kit one half of it (0.5) |
| Exactly two | The first kit carries the full price and the second three quarters of it (0.75) |
| One | That kit carries the full price |

The kits' amount is the price of a kit taken over the kits owed as their places give. Kits already standing hold the first places, so an owed kit carries the full price only when no kit is standing.

## Worked cases

| Appliances installed | Kits standing | Kits owed | Places of the owed kits | Prices taken |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 1 | First | 1 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | First, second | 1 plus 0.75, 1.75 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | Second | 0.75 |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | First, second, third | 1 plus 0.5 plus 0.5, 2 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | Second, third | 0.5 plus 0.5, 1 |
| 4 | 0 | 4 | First to fourth | 1 plus three times 0.5, 2.5 |

**Hypothetical figure.** At a price of $36.00 a kit, two appliances and no kit standing give $36.00 plus $27.00, $63.00.
